Evening Delhi city tour

Old Delhi · Evening · 4 hours

4 hours New Delhi tour packages Private tour Licensed guide

Four hours as the heat drops: Jama Masjid and Chandni Chowk at their busiest, the spice market, and India Gate lit up on the drive back.

At a glance

Duration
About 4 hours
Starts
3 to 4 pm
Transport
Private AC car
Tour type
Private
Guide
Licensed, English speaking
Pickup
Hotel or airport in Delhi NCR

What makes this one worth it

  • Jama Masjid and the skyline from its courtyard
  • Chandni Chowk by rickshaw as the shops light up
  • The Khari Baoli spice market
  • Red Fort photo stop and India Gate lit up after dark

Your tour schedule

  1. 3 – 4 PM

    Pickup

    Pickup from your hotel, the airport or any address in Delhi NCR, and into Old Delhi.

  2. Late afternoon

    Jama Masjid

    One of India's largest mosques, with views across the rooftops of the old city.

  3. Early evening

    Chandni Chowk by rickshaw

    A rickshaw ride through the bazaars, the old shops and the evening crowds.

  4. Evening

    The spice market and the Red Fort

    A walk through Khari Baoli, Asia's largest wholesale spice market, then a photo stop outside the Red Fort while your guide tells its story.

  5. After dark

    India Gate and Parliament, lit up

    A drive past India Gate and Parliament House under the lights, then drop-off at your hotel.

What the price covers

  • Private AC car
  • Licensed Delhi guide
  • Rickshaw ride
  • Bottled water
  • Parking and taxes

What it does not cover

  • Food and drinks
  • Camera fees
  • Tips

Questions people ask

What time does the evening Old Delhi tour start?
We normally pick you up between 3:00 PM and 4:00 PM, depending on what suits you, and the tour lasts about 4 hours.
Is this a private tour or a group tour?
It is a private tour. You have your own AC car, driver and licensed English-speaking guide, so the evening is planned around your interests.
Is the rickshaw ride included in the tour?
Yes, a cycle-rickshaw ride through the busy lanes of Chandni Chowk is part of the experience.
Can I get picked up from Delhi Airport?
Yes. We offer pickup and drop-off at Delhi Airport as well as at hotels across Delhi NCR.
Are monument entry tickets included?
No, monument entry fees are not included in the standard price. You pay at the gate, and your guide helps you get tickets quickly.
Is the evening tour safe for tourists?
Yes. You are with an experienced driver and a professional local guide the whole time, and you travel in a private car, so you can enjoy the evening with peace of mind.
